title: Tree right rotation
summary: Recovered 0x4231e0 right rotation as a genuine thiscall member with header/root replacement and conditional sentinel-parent handling. Original instructions and balancing callers establish link offsets and separation from recoloring.
test_description: 192 original-versus-C++ fixture comparisons covering root, right-child and left-child replacement, transferred subtree nil bytes 0/1/2/255, distinct and shared-header sentinel links, and varied color/payload patterns. Independently constructed expected full-memory images verify all writes and preservation of metadata, color, payload, header extrema and sentinel parents.
known_limits: Requires valid tree links and a rotatable pivot with a left child; null pointers and corrupt trees are outside caller preconditions.
Only the link prefix is recovered; value type and complete owning container layout remain unknown.
Portable pointer-based layout expands on 64-bit Linux; original offsets and ABI apply to 32-bit builds.
No byte-matching claim; broader balancing, allocation and key operations are outside scope.
